findings.explanation: INV-1014's own figures do not reconcile: a total of INR 246,000.00 with GST stated at 18% implies a subtotal of INR 208,474.58 and tax of INR 37,525.42 (or, if tax were truly INR 36,000.00 at 18%, the subtotal would be INR 200,000.00 and the total INR 236,000.00), so the stated subtotal/rate/total combination is internally inconsistent.
